content: Soft delete (deleted_at flag) preserves history references when an employee leaves but silently disables FK guarantees: every query must remember the is-active filter, cascades stop working, deleted rows can re-enter joins. Hard delete orphans children unless ON DELETE behaviors handled. Community-endorsed middle ground for history-keeping apps: archive/audit tables or keep employees as permanent short reference records and mark them inactive rather than deleting; brandur.org soft-deletion critique and HN discussion are the key references, plus Marty Friedel audit-table pattern.
